_README: CANONICAL word lists for the article checker, the AI-tell scorer and the copy linter. This file is the single source of truth: edit a list here and all three tools pick it up. Severity is encoded per category below. Add your own banned words to the restricted_words block (the key is the plain lemma, forms lists what is actually flagged).

restricted_words._source: the writing styleguide: banned or restricted words, each with a plain alternative
restricted_words._note: Keyed by the lemma named in the rulebook (the drift test asserts every rulebook lemma is a key here). 'forms' is what the validator actually flags — this lets us ban the metaphorical/jargon verb while protecting a legitimate noun sense (e.g. 'negotiating leverage', 'financial leverage' are fine; 'leveraging X' is not).

leverage.note: noun sense (bargaining/financial leverage) allowed; ban jargon verb forms only

navigate.note: metaphorical only; literal UI navigation is rare in this content

landscape.note: metaphorical 'market/industry landscape'; literal geography does not occur in B2B payments copy

words: at the end of the day

tier2_overuse._source: shared-skills/writing-styleguide.md -> Tier 2 -> Inflation adjectives / Copula replacements / Verbs

terminology._note: Owner rule (David, 2026-08-24): say 'AI models', never 'AI assistants'. WIRED 2026-08-31 (branch lint-validator-batch-2026-08-31): validate_article.py now derives category names and severities from THIS file rather than a hardcoded list, so this block is enforced as an error, and copy-lint's banned_terms() already picks up every error-severity block. Product names (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) are never flagged — they do not match these forms, and a sentence about a PRODUCT surface gets rewritten to name the app rather than substituted (see the 2026-08-24 ADDENDUM in shared-skills/INBOX.md). Bare 'assistant(s)' is deliberately NOT listed here: the styleguide covers it, but as an error-level regex it would fire across ~930+ instances of already-published content, which is the sweep this rule waits on.
